stories.title: Amazon: China-Linked Hackers’ AI Agents Exploited Medical Software Zero-Day
stories.summary: A threat actor used autonomous Cairn AI agents to discover and exploit a critical MONAI Label vulnerability.

stories.title: Attackers' AI Agents Found a Zero-Day in Medical-Imaging Software and Gained Root Access
stories.summary: Suspected China-linked hackers used autonomous AI agents to find a previously unknown flaw in MONAI Label, an open-source medical imaging server, and gain root access to a university server, Amazon Threat Intelligence said this week.

stories.title: CTO of ‘RansomwareHelp’ Indicted for Wire Fraud
stories.summary: The chief technology officer and co-founder of ransomwarehelp.com, a six year old Florida business that claimed to use "advanced cryptographic tools" to restore data locked by ransomware, has been charged with wire fraud after an FBI sting operation found the company was simply paying the attackers for a decryption key and charging victims a markup for work that was never performed.
stories.why_it_matters: Security teams should review the original reporting, determine whether the development affects their environment, and adjust monitoring or controls when supported by verified details.

stories.title: Microsoft Entra Connect Health flaw exploited to steal tenant data
stories.summary: Microsoft is warning organizations that it suffered a data breach after attackers exploited a vulnerability in its Entra Connect Health service to gain unauthorized access to administrator email addresses and tenant configuration information.
stories.why_it_matters: Potentially affected organizations and individuals should follow confirmed notifications, review exposed-data risk, and strengthen monitoring for follow-on fraud or credential abuse.

stories.title: GnuPG Warns Critical GPGME Flaw Could Expose App Data via Malicious OpenPGP Keys
stories.summary: A malicious OpenPGP key with an unusually long user ID can trigger a critical memory bug in GPGME, the standard library that programs use to work with GnuPG.
stories.why_it_matters: Organizations should inventory potentially affected products, review the original advisory, and monitor for credible exploitation evidence.

stories.title: Signal Blocks AI Agents From Reading Private Chats via Screenshots on Android and iOS
stories.summary: Signal has announced that it will restrict screenshots by default to stop artificial intelligence (AI) agents from reading private chats on Android and iOS devices, but conceded that the protection is "incomplete." The feature applies to agentic systems built into iOS 27 and on Android versions where the encrypted messaging platform can detect an AI assistant attempting to read the Signal
stories.why_it_matters: Security and technology teams should assess the development for changes to model risk, data handling, access controls, and their existing AI governance.
